q2: SELECT CLASS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT STUDENT , CLASS FROM COURSES)T1 GROUP BY CLASS HAVING COUNT(CLASS)>= 5

q2_prompt_sql: SELECT CLASS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT STUDENT , CLASS FROM COURSES)T1 GROUP BY CLASS HAVING COUNT(CLASS)>= 5
explanation: Q1 groups courses by CLASS and selects those with at least 5 courses. Q2 first removes duplicates by selecting distinct STUDENT and CLASS, then groups by CLASS and selects those with at least 5 occurrences of CLASS.
counterexample_dsp: The difference arises when a CLASS appears in the same STUDENT's record multiple times. Q1 will count each occurrence of the CLASS, while Q2 will count the CLASS only once per STUDENT.
